Senior Product Manager (on-site)
description:
Your role
 Cloover's platform now runs how thousands of installers get onboarded, verified, invoiced, and financed. You'll own one of those product areas end to end, from discovery to shipped outcomes, and be the person your squad looks to for what we build next and why. 
 You'll report to our Head of Product, partnering daily with engineers, design, and operations. 
Your mission
 Own the roadmap for your product area, turning company goals into quarterly bets that move installer activation, conversion, or retention. 
 Align engineering, design, and operations in on clear priorities, and coordinate across Cloover where needed. 
 Work closely with your engineers making technical trade-offs, so what we ship is fast now and holds up as we scale. 
 Turn the most ambiguous, high-stakes problems in your area into clear product bets: run discovery with installers and internal teams, dig into usage data, and validate your solutions 
 Stay close to the work: write the specs for the hardest problems yourself, make daily trade-off calls, and ship features that reach real customers and move real metrics. 
 Contribute to how we do product work at Cloover: share what works in discovery and outcome measurement, and support newer PMs informally. 
 Use AI as a default part of how you work and what we build: prototype, research, and analyse with it, and identify where it can automate operational workflows. 
Your profile
 We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role: 
 5+ years in product management, with at least one product or feature area you've owned end-to-end and outcomes you can quantify. 
 You pick up problems outside your remit when nobody owns them, and can explain what you did and what changed as a result. 
 You've set the direction for a product area and can walk us through a bet you made, how you got your team behind it, and what happened. 
 You make decisions with incomplete information and explain your reasoning clearly to engineers, operations, and leadership. 
 You run discovery hands-on: user interviews, data analysis, usability testing, and prototyping to validate direction before building. 
 You've delivered in environments where urgency is the norm, and you know when to ship and when to push back on scope or quality. 
 Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first: decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here. 
 Nice to have (but not required) 
 German language proficiency (B2 or above). 
 Don't meet every requirement?  Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective. Credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling 
How we hire
 We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks. 
 Intro call  (30 min): We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV. 
 Hiring manager interview  (30 min): We go deep into your experience, your thinking, and how you approach problems. 
 Product Deep Dive Interview  (1 hour): A chance for you to show your depth of knowledge and experience. 
 Founder Interview  (30 min): Final stage to meet one of our founders and get a picture of where Cloover is going.  
 Offer & signed contract. 
 Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know. 
Why us?
 Performance pay.  Strong base and a bonus tied to outcomes, recognised when it happens rather than locked behind annual cycles. 
 AI-first & unthrottled.  Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement. 
 Real ownership on a real mission.  From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software. We're powering the energy transition across Europe. 
 Grow faster than anywhere else.  You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in. 
Perks & Benefits
 Latest Apple hardware  in our Prenzlauer Berg office 
 25 days vacation 
 €500 per year  learning & development budget 
 WHOOP Peak, covered.  After six months with us, we cover your WHOOP Peak membership in full 
 Urban Sports Club (M)  membership 
 Deutschlandticket , fully covered 
 Cloover Power Tariff:  our own green power tariff, with the monthly base fee on us 
 Free catered lunch  every day in the office (via Bella&Bona) 
 Free dinner  every day in the office (via Wolt) 
 Fully stocked kitchen  with breakfast, snacks, and drinks 
 Team events  with €50 per person per month 
 Company discounts  via Corporate Benefits and FutureBens

title: AI Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**AI Product Manager (m/f/d)**
==============================
**In Germany** - Berlin | Bonn | Cologne | Frankfurt/Main | Hamburg | Munich
Simon-Kucher’s AI Lab develops AI-powered products that convert our expertise in pricing, commercial strategy, marketing and sales into reusable technology assets for consultants and clients. 
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on product leader who combines genuine AI product management expertise with consulting fluency, commercial judgment and exceptional executive communication. You will work directly with Partners and Senior Partners across industries and with highly experienced engineers. Your mandate is to turn ambiguous, high-value opportunities into focused MVPs and successive releases, often targeting 6–8-week delivery cycles, without compromising customer trust or product quality.
**What makes us special:** 
* Advance your career with exciting professional opportunities in our thriving company with a startup feel.
* Innovate by transforming ideas into cutting-edge AI products, championing AI and Generative AI through creative experimentation to push boundaries and deliver transformative solutions.
* Voice your unique ideas in a culture defined by our entrepreneurial spirit, openness, and integrity
* Feel at home working with our helpful, enthusiastic colleagues who have great team spirit
* Broaden your perspective with our extensive training curriculum and learning programs (e.g. LinkedIn Learning)
* Speak your mind in our holistic feedback and development processes (e.g. 360-degree feedback)
* Satisfy your need for adventure with our opportunities to live and work abroad in one of our many international offices
* Enjoy our benefits, such as hybrid working, daycare allowance, corporate discounts, and wellbeing support (e.g. Headspace)
* Unwind in our break areas where you can help yourself to the healthy snacks and beverages provided
* See another side of your coworkers at our frequent employee events, World Meetings and Holiday Parties
**How you will create an impact:** 
* **Own the product, not just the backlog.** Define product direction, target users, value proposition, and measurable outcomes for AI applications that productize Simon-Kucher know-how and improve consulting delivery or client results.
* **Translate expertise into product opportunities.** Partner with consulting leaders, consultants and end users to turn complex, sometimes unfamiliar industry problems into validated use cases and clearly defined product decisions. 
 Deliver with pace and discipline. Frame lean MVPs, make explicit scope trade-offs, and prioritize the highest-value capabilities for 6–8-week target cycles and subsequent fast iterations.
* **Make decisions that move teams forward.** Create clear problem statements, lean specifications, user journeys and acceptance criteria; prioritize ruthlessly based on evidence, value, technical feasibility and risk.
* **Lead AI product choices.** Evaluate when GenAI, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, conventional analytics or non-AI approaches best solve a business problem, in partnership with engineering.
* **Make AI quality measurable.** Define product-level quality benchmarks and AI evaluations covering accuracy, grounding, reliability, user trust, cost, latency, security and appropriate human oversight.
* **Lead cross-functional execution.** Work as a credible peer to experienced software engineers, AI specialists and designers; challenge and resolve trade-offs while respecting technical ownership.
* **Manage senior stakeholders with confidence.** Drive decisions with Partners and Senior Partners, communicate options and trade-offs crisply, address conflicting priorities and constructively push back when required.
* **Own results beyond launch.** Lead pilots, user feedback, adoption and iterative improvement; manage product risks including confidentiality, data protection, responsible AI and enterprise requirements.
**About you:** 
* Extensive end-to-end product experience (typically 7+ years in product leadership or an equivalent consulting/product combination), with clear accountability for outcomes—not only delivery coordination.
* Hands-on ownership of AI/GenAI products, from zero-to-one MVP through launch, evaluation and improvement; evidence of multiple meaningful AI product iterations.
* Strong practical grasp of LLM-based product patterns—including retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and agentic workflows—as well as evaluation methods, limitations, failure modes and AI-versus-non-AI trade-offs.
* Enough technical depth to work confidently with senior engineers on APIs, data flows, integrations, model and architecture choices, deployment constraints and quality/cost/latency trade-offs. Coding proficiency is not required.
* Product Owner or Agile certification
* Genuine familiarity with strategy consulting or professional-services businesses, consultant workflows, partner-led decision-making and the challenge of transforming expert know-how into reusable client-facing or internal tools.
* Excellent business judgment and structured thinking; able to understand unfamiliar industries rapidly and identify opportunities in pricing, revenue growth, sales or marketing.
* Executive presence and excellent communication; able to influence and constructively challenge Partners and Senior Partners without formal authority.
* A high-ownership, entrepreneurial operating style: comfortable making decisions amid ambiguity, prioritizing hard choices, adapting to feedback and being accountable for results under aggressive timelines.
* Strong user research, experimentation and analytics skills; clear judgment on the viability, desirability and feasibility of enterprise AI products, including confidentiality, privacy and responsible-AI considerations.
* Fluent professional English; German is an advantage.
Have we sparked your interest? Simply click the **“Apply now”** button to submit your application. P

title: Product Owner Client Acquisition
description:
As **Product Owner Client Acquisition**, you help the squad optimise the journey from qualified lead through onboarding, account opening, funding and activation.
You’ll analyse where clients drop off, translate opportunities into backlog items, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Data, Compliance and Operations to fix them.
This is an entry-level product role for mid-career professionals eager to learn product ownership in a conversion-critical part of the business.
**What you’ll do**
* Support the Product Manager with backlog maintenance, sprint prep and progress tracking.
* Translate strategy into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for onboarding and activation.
* Analyse onboarding, funding and activation journeys to identify friction and drop-off.
* Gather requirements from Marketing, Sales, Data, Design, Engineering and Compliance.
* Maintain backlog quality so stories meet the Definition of Ready before sprint planning.
* Help interpret conversion, onboarding and activation performance data.
**Who you are**
You’re curious about onboarding and conversion optimisation, and ready to grow your product craft.
* 2–5 years in product ownership, business analysis, marketing operations, digital marketing, QA or analytics.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing, onboarding processes and activation journeys.
* Comfort with spreadsheets/BI basics; willingness to learn SQL or experimentation tools.
* Fluent English and at least one local LYNX-market language.
**Nice to have**
* Experience within fintech, brokerage or financial services.
* Experience with onboarding, customer acquisition or activation optimisation.
* Experience with customer data platforms or marketing technology integrations.
**What we offer**
* A competitive salary based on experience.
* Flexible working hours at our office in the heart of the city.
* A fixed 13th-month salary.
* Pension scheme for NL/DE/BE.
* Travel expense reimbursement.
* An annual training budget of €2,000, freely allocated to your professional development.
* Team outings, social drinks, and an annual weekend trip with the entire team.
**Who we are**
*“LYNX helps you invest in yourself.” “Working at LYNX means joining the LYNX family.” “The development opportunities make LYNX the best place to work.”*
This is what our employees say about LYNX, and it reflects exactly what we aim to offer: an environment where you can get the best out of yourself.
From our offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Berlin, and Prague, we work every day to provide private and professional clients with the best trading opportunities through a fast, user-friendly, and reliable platform.
LYNX is an international FinTech company where around 300 colleagues contribute to client success across Europe in an informal, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.
We’re an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified and eligible candidates without attention to gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation/identity, disability or neurodiversity.

title: Technical Product Manager, API Integrations (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager, API Integrations to join our Supply domain , more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonizing data structures and building revenue-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scale our business, therefore our focus is on innovation and automation.
 What you will do:
 Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities.
 Automate and innovate our existing inventory (our API product is already used by big players).
 Own scoping and management of onboarding new carriers; establish wider scope throughout Asia.
 Take a lead role in defining and challenging strategic decisions.
 Contribute to the team with process improvements (e.g. Jira, reporting etc.).
 Build relationships with key stakeholders (internal/external – C-level).
 Workplace: Berlin- hybrid, Germany - remote.
 Who you are:
 Product Management background: 3+ years of professional experience, with hands-on exposure to the technical side of the product (APIs / data products) — experience with complex products is a plus.
 Stakeholder management: strong track record influencing without direct authority, while comfortably context-switching and showing proactivity and ownership across your responsibilities.
 Management skills: solid grounding across product, process, project, developed within cross-functional teams.
 Background: technical or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; fluent in English, both verbal and written.
 What you can expect:
 Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.
 Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.
 Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.
 Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
 Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.
 Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow. 
 Our hiring process for this role:
 For any questions, you can contact your Talent Partner (TP), Benedetta, at (talent@distribusion.com).
Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? Come join us!

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech Logistics (all genders)
description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.
As Team Tech-Logistics, we are responsible for developing solutions across the entire logistics process in an agile environment - from the delivery of goods and ordering process to shipments and returns management. Our goal is to make order delivery and returns as convenient as possible for our customers while making the logistics behind them as efficient, reliable, and fast as possible.
 Your Responsibilities
 Co-create a compelling product vision by using data, customer insights, and market trends to shape the way forward and continuously improve the customer experience.
 Develop and validate hypotheses around user problems, translate them into user stories and requirements, and work closely with development teams throughout the product development process.
 Drive sprint planning and other agile product development activities, while prioritizing and managing the product backlog to maximize customer value and ROI.
 Create and continuously improve software solutions across at least one of our major logistics areas: stock management, returns management, shipment and label management, making our logistics operations more efficient, reliable, and customer-friendly.
 Collaborate closely with stakeholders from other departments and development teams to align priorities, drive decision-making, and successfully deliver high-value product features.
 Explore and leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve logistic processes, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.
 Your Qualifications
 Proven track record in eCommerce and Logistics, with a focus on Product Management or Product Ownership in an agile environment, ideally with hands-on experience.
 Strong understanding of the end-to-end logistics journeys, including the customer experience, operational processes, and underlying technology.
 Strong customer and data-driven mindset, using insights, analysis, and user feedback to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and make informed product decisions.
 Experience in defining product visions and strategies, translating them into a clear roadmap, and delivering measurable customer and business value.
 Experience in analyzing, elaborating, and prioritizing business and technical requirements, with excellent technical understanding of processes, systems, and web applications. Ideally, you also have experience with AI, automation, or AI-powered products and are excited about applying AI within logistics and eCommerce.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with an empathetic and positive approach to working with stakeholders and development teams. 
 Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus.
 At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

title: Product Manager - Pro Tools (m/w/d)
description:
immowelt – where new chapters begin
 A new home is more than an address – it's the place where a new chapter begins. Since 1991, as one of Germany's leading online real estate marketplaces, we've brought millions of people exactly there. Our mission is to digitalize every step of the real estate transaction, making it as simple as possible for house-hunters, sellers, or agents – from the first search all the way to financing. Operated by AVIV Germany GmbH, immowelt is part of the AVIV Group – one of the largest real estate tech companies. Here, decades of market expertise meet the power of a global PropTech network.
 Find the team that's right for you.
 Don't look for just any colleagues – find a team that shares your drive! Whether in Software Development, Sales, Product Management or Brand Marketing: at immowelt, tech visionaries, data specialists and creative talents work together across locations like Nuremberg, Berlin and Hamburg. We live a culture where ideas count for more than hierarchy. We've got each other's backs – whether at a shared B2Run, at summer parties, or relaxing over Guten-Morgen-Müsli in the team lounge. Whether you bring professional experience, are a manager, or an ambitious career-changer: with us, it's your potential that counts.
 About The Job
 AVIV is Europe's largest real estate tech company, backed by KKR. Our teams build the technology and business models shaping how people across France, Germany and Belgium buy, sell, rent, lend and own property.
In Germany, our teams run a major share of the business through immowelt.de — a Top 2 German portal for valuation, rent, buy and sell, with 18m average monthly visits, 19.3k agents, 320k+ listings, and €168m revenue in 2023.
 Role Summary
 This role owns a bounded slice of the Pro Tools surface (e.g. statistics, invoice self-serve, or a specific stage of the agent portfolio experience) and ships measurable improvements against agent-experience metrics — the delivery engine next to the Staff PM, turning framed problems into shipped, measured solutions.
 Responsibilities
 Answer who your users are, why they need the product, and what their needs are
 Continuously track product success and health metrics
 Generate, collect and prioritize hypotheses for product improvement
 Test hypotheses with the team to build understanding of the product and drive specific improvements
 Build the product backlog based on qualitative and quantitative data
 Write specs / user stories for product improvements
 Set product tasks for the team and explain the product logic — why, for what reason, for whom
 Present results at team events
 Proactively ensure transparency of goals and results for stakeholders
 Take into account the interests of other units and departments, and see the full picture
 Back up the Engineering Manager on development-team management issues — monitor problems, propose solutions
 Required Experience
 Experience in marketplaces/classifieds or B2B products
 Experience with customer-facing product interfaces, with a track record of improving funnel conversion
 Native German speaker
 Skillset
 Critical thinking, ability to build valid argumentation
 Ability and willingness to prove/justify one's decisions
 Empathy, ability and willingness to put oneself in others' shoes — viewing the product from the perspective of users and their needs
 Commitment to continuous self-development
 Clarity of thought, both verbal and written
 Understanding of Lean Startup approaches
 Key areas of project management: planning, risk management, stakeholder management, communications management
 Working with AI tools
 Ability to effectively use LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to speed up product work: generating hypotheses, specs, user stories, data analysis
 Prompt engineering — ability to formulate queries to AI models to get high-quality results
 Using AI tools for user research: interview analysis, insight synthesis, feedback clustering
 Ability to formulate product requirements for AI features
 Understanding of the unit economics of AI features
 Ability to assess where in the product AI creates real value versus where it's a hype feature without ROI
 Understanding of data privacy issues when using AI
 Skills
 Ability to formulate the data needs required to work through a task
 Ability to validate a product hypothesis through experiments, articulate expectations for metrics and outcomes
 Proficiency with key product work tools and approaches: story mapping, impact mapping, MVP
 Knowledge of basic approaches to product metrics and data analytics (Excel, Google Analytics, Tableau/Snowflake)
 Understanding of where different user research approaches apply: in-depth interviews, hallway testing
 Methods for prioritizing the product backlog (e.g., Kano, RICE)
 Describing product tasks from the user's and business's perspective
 Presentation and public speaking skills in front of audiences of up to 100 people
 Basics of Agile approaches: Scrum, Kanban
 What We Offer
 We offer you real freedom and strong benefits:
 Flexible working hours & leave: Individual arrangements and part-time options by agreement, plus up to 30 days of leave per year
 Training and coaching: Regular internal training, external development opportunities, and individual coaching as a core part of onboarding
 Company pension & benefits: An attractive, financially supported pension model and capital-forming benefits paid in full
 Mobility, transport links & parking: A free Deutschlandticket, JobRad bike leasing, or simple rental of a fixed parking space in the immowelt car park for a small fee
 Sport, fitness & health: Urban Sports Club memberships, a monthly contribution toward professional massages, and mental health support via Kyan Health
 Food: Guten-Morgen-Müsli, fresh fruit & vegetables, coffee, tea and water on the house, plus cozy lounges for cooking and getting together at the Nuremberg and Berlin locations
 Employee discounts: Exclusive offers and discounts via Corpo

title: Senior Product Manager AI -  — Studio Builder
description:
Our vision
 We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System for French SMEs and Accounting Firms — and soon, European ones.
We help entrepreneurs get rid of time-consuming accounting and financial tasks while giving them access to the information they need to make better decisions for their business.
 About Us
 Pennylane is one of the fastest-growing Fintechs in France — and soon in Europe.
In five years, we have:
 💻 Built a groundbreaking accounting and financial platform for SMEs and accounting firms
 💰 Raised €225 million from leading investors, including Sequoia
 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grown from 7 co-founders to more than 850 Pennylaners
 🌍 Built an international and remote-friendly environment with more than 25 nationalities
 🤝 Earned the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms
 🚀 Reached more than 700,000 SMEs and 4,500 accounting firms in France
 Why this position is critical to our mission
 At Pennylane, Product is at the heart of how we create value for our customers.
We are now making a major bet on AI: not only to automate existing workflows, but also to fundamentally change how people interact with their financial software and extend what the product can do.
Our AI ecosystem is being built across several complementary layers:
 A shared AI platform, or “harness”, that provides the foundations required to run reliable agents: context, memory, tools, skills, loops, guardrails and observability
 Studio Coworker, a conversational product experience that helps users analyse information and take action inside Pennylane
 Autopilot, which automates accounting and financial workflows to reduce manual data entry
 Studio Builder, the product you will own, enabling users to build and deploy personalised apps, automations and agents on top of Pennylane
 Studio Builder is our most ambitious AI product initiative.
The idea is simple but powerful: give customers the ability to extend Pennylane according to their own needs, without requiring them to build everything from scratch. Users should be able to describe what they want to achieve and rely on AI to create, configure and deploy the right experience directly within Pennylane.
This could unlock a new way to use financial software: more personalised, more extensible and increasingly capable of adapting to every company’s specific workflows.
As Senior Product Manager, AI, you will shape this product from the ground up. You will define the vision, understand where AI can create genuine customer value and turn a highly complex technical ambition into a simple, useful and scalable product experience.
You will join one of the key teams shaping the future of Pennylane.
You can also read more about Pennylane’s position at the intersection of AI, accounting and financial software in The New York Times .
 What You Will Own
 The vision and strategy for Studio Builder
 You will define how Studio Builder should help customers create, personalise and extend Pennylane.
You will identify the most valuable use cases, understand where customers struggle today and establish a clear product strategy that balances ambition, usability and technical feasibility.
 The End-to-end Building Experience
 You will own the experience through which customers:
 Define what they want to build
 Configure the relevant data, context, tools and actions
 Test and iterate on their app, automation or agent
 Deploy it within Pennylane
 Monitor its usage and improve it over time
 The foundations of an extensible AI product
 You will work closely with the AI platform team to ensure that Studio Builder makes the underlying capabilities of Pennylane accessible and useful to customers.

description:

Having fun at work is important! It is a great way to bond and get to know each other better (but of course it is never an obligation!). 
 In more formal terms, we are a consulting firm specializing in engineering, IT and digital project management. We are an international company with a Franco-German DNA. Our 3,500 employees are of 45 different nationalities and are spread across 27 offices in 10 countries, including France, Germany, Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Portugal, Egypt, and the Netherlands.
 About the role 
 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our team and drive the delivery of
 complex, multidisciplinary robotic systems from concept through deployment and field
 sustainment. In this role, you will be the connective link between mechanical, electrical,
 software, and systems engineering teams — ensuring that tightly coupled hardware and
 software workstreams converge on time, on budget, and at the quality bar our customers
 expect.
 You will own the end-to-end program execution for robotic system development, including new
 product introduction (NPI), design iterations, cost-down initiatives, and retrofit programs across
 fielded fleets. You will operate in a fast-paced environment where trade-offs between
 disciplines are the norm, and your ability to drive clarity, manage risk, and hold teams
 accountable across engineering boundaries will be critical to success.
 You will work hands-on with physical systems — understanding mechanical assemblies,
 electrical architectures, and control software
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and drive integrated program schedules, governance mechanisms (design reviews, change boards, milestone gates), and risk management across mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineering workstreams -- from concept through production ramp and field deployment.
 Coordinate new product introduction (NPI) activities including prototyping, design verification testing (DVT), production validation testing (PVT), and manufacturing readiness.
 Drive cost reduction, design-for-excellence (DFx) initiatives, and retrofit/upgrade programs for fielded robotic systems by translating field feedback, failure data, and operational metrics into engineering priorities and actionable improvement plans.
 Define and track program KPIs (e.g., schedule adherence, risk burn-down, cost targets, field reliability metrics) and report status to senior leadership with clear, data-driven narratives.
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional and geographically distributed partners -- including product management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, safety/compliance, field operations, and external partners (e.g., contract manufacturers) -- to ensure consistent execution.
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience with multi-disciplinary teams of mechanical, electrical and software engineers.
 Experience managing programs across multiple teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules.
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide training and guidance to co-workers.
 Experience managing technical programs through the full product lifecycle — from concept and prototyping through integration, testing, and deployment.
 Demonstrated ability to create and maintain integrated program schedules across hardware, software, and systems engineering workstreams.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems and hardware change management processes (e.g., ECOs, design reviews, BOM management).
 Familiarity with DFx methodologies (Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, Reliability, Serviceability) and their impact on program planning.
 Experience working with service and field operations organizations to translate field feedback into engineering priorities and actionable improvement plans.
 Familiarity with robotic subsystems such as end-effectors, conveyance, lifting mechanisms, or operator workstations

title: Ehrenamt · remote · 4–6 Std./Woche: Assistenz Chief of Staff – COO Office (m/w/d)

**Gleich vorweg: Das ist ein Ehrenamt**

Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und bringt sie mit Menschen aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Wissenschaft zusammen, damit soziales Engagement mehr bewirkt. Wir verbinden Verbände, schaffen professionelle Strukturen und bauen bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf. * Gremienarbeit unterstützen: Bei der organisatorischen Betreuung von Fachkräfterat, Kuratorium und weiteren Gremien mitwirken
* Sitzungen und Veranstaltungen organisieren: Termine koordinieren, Einladungen versenden, Anmeldungen verwalten und Unterlagen vorbereiten
* Aufgaben nachhalten: Offene Punkte, Zuständigkeiten und Fristen gemeinsam mit der Chief of Staff im Blick behalten

* Dokumentation und Ablage: Besprechungsergebnisse und Unterlagen in Microsoft 365 strukturiert pflegen
* Abläufe verbessern: Ideen für eine einfachere und effizientere Zusammenarbeit einbringen
Du musst nicht alles übernehmen. Gemeinsam schauen wir, wo deine Stärken liegen und welche Aufgaben du eigenverantwortlich betreuen möchtest.

* Freude an Organisation, Kommunikation und strukturiertem Arbeiten
* Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in Assistenz, Büroorganisation, Projektkoordination, Veranstaltungsmanagement oder Vereinsarbeit
* Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen; Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, Planner, SharePoint) ist von Vorteil
* Sorgfältige, eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Bereitschaft, uns regelmäßig etwa 4–6 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen
**Was wir dir bieten**
*Sinn & Gemeinnutz*
* Deine Arbeit hilft, dass unsere ehrenamtlichen Teams, Gremien und Verantwortlichen wirkungsvoll zusammenarbeiten und gesellschaftliches Engagement gestärkt wird.
* Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen wollen.
*Exklusives Netzwerk*
* Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen
* Austausch mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen ganz unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen
* Zugriff auf das Know-how unserer angeschlossenen Organisationen und Kooperationspartner
*Gestaltung & Verantwortung*

* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Chief of Staff und Einblick in das COO Office und die Gremienarbeit
* Möglichkeit, schrittweise mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen
*Entwicklung & Referenz*

* Eine starke Referenz: Mitarbeit in einer zentralen Organisationsfunktion einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation
* Qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis und Tätigkeitsnachweis
*So arbeiten wir zusammen*
* Komplett remote mit Microsoft 365, deine Zeit teilst du dir weitgehend flexibel ein
* Klare Absprachen: Aufgaben, Zeitumfang und feste Termine halten wir in einer kurzen Ehrenamtsvereinbarung fest

Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungsmarathon: Schreib uns in drei, vier Sätzen, welche organisatorischen Erfahrungen du mitbringst, was dir besonders liegt und warum dich dieses Ehrenamt reizt. Danach lernen wir uns in einem kurzen virtuellen Gespräch kennen und schauen gemeinsam, ob es passt.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) - Data Centres
description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.​
 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.​
 Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.​
 We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.​
 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
 Job Description
 Turner & Townsend are leaders in professional services to the Data Centre sector globally. Due to the continued success and expansion of our Data Centre business in Germany, we are currently recruiting for experienced Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) to join our Data Centre team in Berlin. 
 In this role, you will oversee the pre-construction, construction, commissioning, and close-out phases of a hyperscale, state of the art data center project for a global technology client onsite.
 With a market leading client base and the opportunity to take the lead on strategic commissions and high-profile projects, this is an exciting time to join the business unit and grow a career with Turner & Townsend.
 Responsibilities:
 Manage the entire project lifecycle, from design to construction to commissioning, ensuring that the project is completed within budget, on time, and to the required quality standards as the key client interface
 Develop working relationships, problem solving and driving projects to successful completion
 Collaborate with stakeholders, including clients, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities, to ensure that project requirements are met and any issues are resolved
 Manage the design process to achieve the client's requirements and manage expectations
 Review project plans and specifications, scheduling, costs saving measures, discrepancies, potential construction problems, etc. 
 Ensure that all aspects of the project, including safety, quality, and environmental standards, are in compliance with industry regulations and standards
 Co-ordinating vendor scope with overall project delivery
 Working closely with project teams to ensure effective and timely document processing and management of contract documents
 Prepare regular reports for stakeholders, including progress updates, budget status, and risk management
 Qualifications
 University degree in a Construction a related field. 
 Several years project management experience, gained within a Data Centre or similar technical environment. 
 Technical understanding of Data Centre Infrastructure – HVAC, Electrical, Generators, Fire, Security and BMS. 
 A thorough understanding of the total project life cycle, from project inception stage, design, authority approvals through to construction completion and post-project review. 
 Excellent knowledge and experience of all of the main project management concepts, tools and techniques. 
 Ability to thrive in a high pressure, fast paced environment. 
 Highly motivated and driven with a passion for delivering to your client. 
 Fluent English and German language skills are a must. 
 Availability for fulltime on-site work. 
 Additional Information
 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. 
 Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

title: Product Manager - Remote
description:
We are looking for a strategic, user-centric, and data-driven Product Manager to lead end-to-end product strategy and execution for our US Based client.
In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery lifecycle for core web and mobile software offerings. You will collaborate directly with US executives, product leads, software engineers, and UI/UX designers to translate customer insights and market opportunities into high-impact products.
 Responsibilities
 Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define the short-term sprint goals and long-term product vision, prioritizing features based on user value, market research, and business goals.
 Requirements & Story Mapping: Draft clear product requirement documents (PRDs), epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira to guide engineering execution.
 Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and software developers to ensure seamless feature delivery aligned with sprint commitments.
 User & Market Research: Analyze customer feedback, user behavior data, and competitive benchmarks to discover pain points and validate new feature concepts.
 Product Analytics & Metrics: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) like activation, retention, monthly active users (MAU), and feature adoption to drive iterative improvements.
 US Stakeholder Alignment: Participate in daily product syncs, sprint reviews, and backlog grooming sessions scheduled during overlapping US business hours.
 Requirements
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
 Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Manager, Associate Product Manager, or Product Owner for SaaS or digital products.
 Tooling Proficiency: Expertise using product management and Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, and product analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics).
 Agile Execution: Proven track record of managing product backlogs, leading sprint ceremonies, and shipping features within Scrum or Kanban frameworks.
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills for collaborating directly with US leadership and global engineering teams.
 Nice to have
 Direct experience working remotely with US-based tech startups, enterprise SaaS platforms, or global remote teams.
 Strong technical background (e.g., prior experience as a Software Engineer, Systems Analyst, or Technical BA).
 Professional certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Pragmatic Institute Certified.
 Benefits
 Competitive Compensation: Premium salary package matching international remote software standards.
 Global Product Exposure: Direct influence over product decisions for a growing US market audience.
 Flexible Work Environment: Remote or hybrid flexibility with hardware and workspace setup allowances.
 Career Growth: Opportunities to scale into senior product leadership roles within a fast-expanding global engineering ecosystem.
 Apply for this role on HireOrbit.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Enablement - Analytics: Capital One Shopping (Remote-Eligible)
description:
Senior Product Manager, AI Enablement - Analytics: Capital One Shopping (Remote-Eligible)
Come join our growing team in Capital One Shopping - the AI Enablement team builds and owns the AI products and platforms the rest of the organization runs on.
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep data platform experience to own Shopping’s agentic analytics platform. Applied AI experience is a plus, and we value candidates who are builders and actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to prototype rather than specify, and who’d rather ship a PoC than write a doc about it. Show us what you’ve built.
 Capital One Product Framework
 In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:
 Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
 Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
 Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
 Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks 
 Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment
 What we are looking for:
 Deep experience with enterprise data and how it’s defined and governed (semantic and metrics layers, data catalogs, ontologies, warehouse and BI, etc.)
 Familiarity with tools across the modern data stack (dbt, LookML, Snowflake, Databricks, Palantir Foundry, Looker, Mode, etc.)
 Familiarity with how AI agents work across structured data (text-to-SQL, tool use, evals, and where these systems fail)
 Someone who has adjudicated metric disputes and made the decision stick
 A builder who would rather be in the tools prototyping than be dependent on someone else to run them
 Comfort with backend and internal platform products, where the users are diverse business and technical teams, and the measure is whether they trust the outputs
 A strategic thought leader who can create a compelling vision and story to present to senior executives and inspire direct and partner teams
 A strong communicator who can advance initiatives and create consensus through clear, concise, and contextually relevant messaging
 Someone who works with minimal direction and a mandate that’s still taking shape
 Deep work experience handling large data files using SQL, Python, and/or R
 What you’ll do:
 Partner with platform engineers to build and operate AI products that teams across Shopping depend on, starting with an agentic analytics platform 
 Understand the enterprise data requirements and ensure the system’s compliance with enterprise patterns
 Define what a system needs to know to be trusted (the data, the definitions, the context behind both)
 Set the boundaries for what agents can and can’t do, and prove those boundaries hold in practice
 Relentlessly push to understand user and stakeholder needs and ensure they are considered in prioritization and trade-off discussions
 Make each successive deployment cheaper and faster than the last 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with leaders and stakeholders that depend on the capabilities and performance of our platforms
 Define, socialize, and monitor key performance indicators to understand the evolution and success of the project
 Basic Qualifications:
 At least 4 years of experience in Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience
 Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
 A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing
 OR
 Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience 
 Preferred Qualifications:
 7+ years of Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience, including ownership of an internal platform or a production deployment into a real operating environment
 4+ years of experience working directly in data, with a deep proficiency in SQL
 Experience defining and governing metrics across teams that did not agree 
 Experience with semantic layers, metrics layers, or ontologies (dbt, LookML, Cube, Palantir Foundry, or comparable)
 At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.
 Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.
